top_signals.title: Global Debt Toolkit Faces Fresh Test in Senegal
top_signals.summary: Senegal is using the Group of 20 Common Framework to rework its debt, a fresh test for the global toolkit to help poor nations avoid chaotic defaults. The African nation is aiming to use an improved version of the framework to secure a fair distribution of relief across creditors. Bloomberg's Matthew Hill breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: Renault CEO Says Nissan Needs to Speed Overhaul
top_signals.summary: Renault SA Chief Executive Officer Francois Provost discusses Nissan's overhaul plan, which he says is "good," but adds that the automaker will have to "boost up" a bit its transformation to get on top of the industry's challenges. Provost speaks with Bloomberg’s Caroline Connan at the Paris Motor Show. (Source: Bloomberg)
